meetings.ours_headline: Open Space Committee voted to recommend the town use its right of first refusal on 250 Howard Street land.

votes.quote: review and approve minutes from 12/10/2019 - committee unanimously approved the minutes.

votes.motion: Elect Paula Bertram as Vice-Chair of the Committee.
votes.quote: karin menard nominated paula bertram, lynn mann seconded. passed unanimously.

votes.motion: Recommend to the Board of Selectmen acquisition of the 250 Howard Street parcel.
votes.quote: paula bertram made a motion to recommend acquisition of this parcel to the board of selectmen, seconded by lynn mann. passed unanimously.

votes.motion: Recommend to the permit granting authorities that they pursue an acquisition or easement of a small portion of the Bright Farms property to allow connectivity between the Table Rock Saliba South parcel and the Rayno Conservation land.
votes.quote: paula bertram made a motion to recommend to the permit granting authorities that they pursue an acquisition or easement of a small portion of the property

meetings.ours_headline: Open Space Committee backed a 200-foot brook setback at 250 Howard St and sent two parcels to Conservation.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the 8/20/2020 meeting, with the spelling of Lynne Man's name corrected.
votes.quote: the minutes were unanimously accepted by roll call vote with the condition that the spelling of lynne man's name be corrected.

votes.motion: Recommend the Selectmen enter into an agreement with the prospective buyers to acquire by gift a portion of 250 Howard Street extending 200 feet beyond the Mulpus Brook.
votes.quote: bob pease made a motion to recommend to the selectmen that they enter into an agreement with the prospective buyers

votes.motion: Recommend the Board of Selectmen convey the Mulpus Road Rear and NW Townsend Road Rear parcels to the Conservation Commission.
votes.quote: bob pease made a motion to recommend that the board of selectmen convey said parcels, lynne man seconded.

votes.motion: Recommend the Board of Selectmen convey the 100 x 150 foot portion of 671 West Street to the abutter and defer action on the other requests.
votes.quote: bob pease made a motion to recommend to the board of selectmen to convey the 100 x 150 foot portion of the parcel to

votes.motion: Recommend to the Board of Selectmen and the Planning Board that they empower the Open Space Committee to examine undesignated municipal lands and make recommendations on use or conveyance.
votes.quote: bob pease made a motion to recommend to the board of selectmen and the planning board that they empower the open space committee

votes.motion: That the Town Boards see acquisition of the northeast corner of the Bright Farms land by gift to provide connectivity between the Raino and Saliba parcels.
votes.quote: karin menard made a motion that the town boards see acquisition of the northeast corner of the land by gift to provide connectivity
at 7:32 p.m. karin menard made a motion to adjourn.

meetings.ours_headline: Open Space Committee voted to ask selectmen for more time before recommending on the 360 Flat Hill Road orchard.
Open Space Committee voted to recommend the town waive its right of first refusal on 360 Flat Hill Road.

votes.quote: bob pease made a motion to approve the minutes of 10/13/2020, seconded by lynne man. approved unanimously by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Recommend to the Selectmen that the Town waive its right of first refusal on 360 Flat Hill Road (Chapter 61A withdrawal)
votes.quote: paula bertram made a motion to recommend to the selectmen that the town waive its right of first refusal, mike toohill seconded, passed unanimously by roll call vote.
paula bertram made a motion to adjourn at 8:23 p.m., lynne man seconded. voted unanimously by roll call vote.

meetings.ours_headline: Open Space Committee declined the Forest Legacy project and began reviewing town-owned parcels for lake access

votes.motion: Approve the 11/24/2020 minutes, with Brandon's minor change to item #3 accepted by amendment.
votes.quote: bob pease made a motion to approve the minutes, mike toohill seconded.
meeting adjourned at 8:00 p.m. by unanimous roll call vote.
